d:
A direct chronological backup of TF artist 10Hwan, sourced via gallery-DL up until they nuked most of their pages sometime ~mid 2025. This one was a big loss IMO, just about everything they ever uploaded had something interesting going for it.

Given the low upload count across sources, I just antidupl'd out the best version of each image and mashed all three accounts in here; I also have a backup of their Furaffinity, but as everything there was a duplicate of content elsewhere, nothing from it made it in here.

*NOTE*: While https://e-hentai.org/g/3651351/6d34d5b015/ DOES already exist, archiving much the same content, it is 1. scraped from limited res sources (1280x), 2. has less sourceable (though still chronologically adequate) filenames, and is 3. missing a small subset of content (mostly just a single animation's frames, though). Only noticed it after putting in the work on organizing this though, so I figure what the hell, publish it anyway.

Content derived from:
https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/62307492 (Nuked ~2025)
https://twitter.com/1_0Hwan (Nuked ~2025)
https://x.com/1Nawh10 (Nuked ~2025)

Not derived from, given it's all dupes:
https://www.furaffinity.net/user/10hwan/

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Note that I've also scraped thousands of other art accounts, for every eyecatching Transformation and TF-Adjacent (IE Hypno, Trait Change...) specialist I can find - so if someone you liked got nuked at any point post-2022, check https://zerobin.net/?9e1b4632b2a0edb0#g+Z0HZUY39NU8rWIighbyGhdsCBKgHJT0zBhlo71QwM= (or the more up to date 'interests' section of my forum profile) for an availability list, give me a DM if you see something what's been lost, and I'll see about throwing them in a gallery too.

I do also have raw .json files for every most every file I've scraped, so if you're the sort to want post metadata as well, give me a ping and I'll hook you up there too.
